title: apply writes a tested row for a weak rules miss with no missing key word from the pack's lead passage
goal: ql_apply.rules_one, for an open rules finding whose entry has no answer_lines, verdict weak and no key_missing (every key word of the question is in some printed passage), takes the first printed passage of pack --root _self on the working tree as the answering line, picks its anchor phrase by the existing anchor_phrases rule and tries the lookup_eval.csv row through the same gates as a reader-anchored row (the whole rag.py eval passes, the mean pack does not grow, off-kb good does not rise); a row that fails the gates leaves the finding no-fix as today, and a finding with key_missing or a none verdict still waits for a person. On the committed store this writes rows for the four such findings open on 2026-10-08 or records why each failed.
notes: Premise (2026-10-08, main 6be3dcd0): open rules findings with verdict weak, key_missing null and answer_lines null: F-11529e5ccd23 and F-3f782b1db5f9 ('what is a sprint'), F-d8ff98fc623c ('how is an operator decision recorded in _decisions.csv from a gate answer'), F-decfa7d6bc47 ('who runs kbgit.py publish to the public GitHub home and how is its state checked'), and F-80eef23e135d / F-a2e8bb7be347 ('what must a gate about AGENTS.md or README.md state in each option'); apply leaves each open and prints how many need a person (kb/_self/querylog.md, Apply, Rules findings). The lead passage is a guess the gates check, never a fact: a wrong passage fails the anchor check or the eval and leaves no-fix. Depends on ST-w2imqyyf so the item-text findings are gone before this runs over the store; ST-fsjwit6r writes the same rows by hand for this week's misses, so after both only new misses reach this rule. Precheck 2026-10-08: both checks pass before the work because the fixture store holds no weak rules finding with empty key_missing; the work plants one with its expected lookup_eval row in the fixture and test_redact.py, so apply on the fixture fails until rules_one anchors from the lead passage. Planted failure: a finding whose lead passage yields no anchor phrase stays no-fix. Check side effect: apply --store on the fixture writes findings and, when a row is accepted, the clone's kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv (apply writes to the working tree, kb/_self/querylog.md Apply). The work makes the fixture check converge (the expected findings file committed beside the run file, as ST-w2imqyyf does for learn) and the planted finding's row is one the file already holds afterwards, so a rerun changes nothing; the worker verifies git status is clean after the check.
